defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Take 40% less damage for 12 seconds; press it the moment you expect to be hit hard, while you still have plenty of health rather than after the hit lands.

defensives.name: Earth Elemental
defensives.usage_rule: With Primordial Bond it stops taunting and instead gives you 15% extra maximum health for its duration; without it, summon it to tank non-boss enemies or take pressure off the tank.
